onset_definition: previous callback state OK/OK_KLT (2/5), current state not 2/5; initialization is not an onset

diagnostic_summary.pose_scope: last pose call counts; window coordinates are native RGBD monocular-camera projections at each call; other sensors omitted

C_01_P0.map_history_scope: Epochs split known map-ID changes and same-ID resets. P3 has unlocalized merges, so these are not fully isolated unchanged-map histories; no merge correctness qualification.

epoch_decay.method: Within separate coordinate epoch; only actual local calls with current_frame_valid. Nonoverlapping first10/last10 for >=30 calls; sensitivity calls11-20/last10 for >=40. Exploratory sign comparison, not causal proof or a decay rate.

point_windows.scope: Stored prefix only; stage3/kind3 post-call snapshots. Live-world projection distance is NOT the optimizer edge chi2; no GT depth accuracy. Selection/drop differences preclude global cross-config pixel/depth conclusions.

lifetime.scope: 100000-row truncated serial prefix; no full lifetime survival ratio. KF-referenced construction is not proof of retained persistent point. Aggregate Birth also includes temporary constructors; do not equate it with mapping supply.

bow.scope: Empty flag printed only on reference coarse<10 failure; zero logs is not a full audit of every KF read. Source mapping only if full ordered coarse-log/counter counts and values agree.

same_source_comparison.scope: Identical original input ordinals, but maps/states/histories differ; conditional descriptive comparison, not overall benefit evidence or isolated per-match causal identification. The final_OK subset excludes difficult failures by selection.

limits: All four frame streams lossless; coordinate and lifetime detail truncated.
NA is not zero; seed frame has no actual local inlier measurement.
Pose counters are last method call; window pixels are live-world boundary projections, not frozen optimizer-edge chi2.
Point Birth aggregate includes all constructors; seed/temporary/KF-referenced construction is not retained mapping population or lifetime success.
Life details only serial prefix, aggregate counts continue but have no full cohort duration/exit attribution.
P3 has 2/3 unlocalized merge groups; epoch labels do not fully isolate map-history changes. KF set additions/removals include transfers/reinsertions and are not unique creation counts.
workers_joined=false: safe sealed recorder output is not proof every backend job completed.
No ground truth pose or depth accuracy; 65535 is not assumed invalid.
